_shape: Investigation. Read-only fan-out across several areas.
_why_this_works: Breadth-first search over independent directions is the case where several agents beat one. Nothing is written, so there are no conflicting decisions to compare and no merge step.
_rules: Use mode pane, not worktree. A member that writes nothing needs no isolation and leaves no branch to clean up.
Demand file:line evidence for every claim. Opinions from a member you cannot cross-examine are worth little.
Set short deadlines. A survey still running after 15 minutes has gone wrong.

The work is reading, not designing, so its task class is `read_only_survey`. Run `teamwire models --for read_only_survey` and pick a model that reads well at a modest cost. A member whose question is a race or a data-loss path gets the class `concurrency_data_loss` instead, and the stronger model and higher effort that class needs.
